# Fixture allowlist for rust-clock-lint.yml's `allowlist-file` input.
#
# Deliberately NOT at the input's default path (.github/clock-lint-allowlist.txt)
# so the fixture's default-path runs still exercise the built-in baseline.
#
# `*` crosses `/`. Comments and blank lines are ignored.
#
# A committed allowlist REPLACES the baseline, it does not extend it. That is
# why this file suppresses src/lib.rs's four violations yet leaves
# src/adapters/system_clock.rs — baseline-allowlisted, not listed here —
# counted. `tests/clock_lint.bats` asserts exactly that: 1 violation, not 0.
# A repo adopting an allowlist must therefore carry its adapter paths over.

*/src/lib.rs          # suppresses every violation in the fixture

# A pattern that matches nothing, to prove a longer allowlist does not start
# matching by accident.
*/src/not_a_real_file.rs
